BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT, e.g. "Bearer eyJhbGc...".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

info.description: Backend API for Palabatu, a community app for Indonesian bouldering enthusiasts (spot map, climber profiles, route/problem listings, comments, reactions, reports).
info.title: Palabatu API

post.description: Creates the approach and every step in one call. Requires at least one step, each with a photo and a caption. Gated by authz.CanContribute (creator-or-admin today, see handoff.md decision 22).

delete.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title), or the approach's own creator.

get.description: The reading view's one call -- every step, in order, ready for offline caching.
get.summary: Get an approach guide, with its ordered steps

post.description: Any authenticated user may add a boulder to any crag, including someone else's; no role gate.

get.description: Admin-only (Council/Associate title) review queue, with every objection filed against each request embedded.

post.description: Only the source or target boulder's own creator may object. Informs the admin's decision, does not block it.

oneOf.description: Why this isn't the same rock

requestBody.description: Why this isn't the same rock

post.summary: Object to a suggested merge ("this is not the same rock")

post.description: Admin-only. action="merge" requires survivor_id (the admin's pick of which boulder survives) and is blocked by a 48h objection hold unless override_hold is set. action="reject" needs no wait.

409.description: already resolved, or the 48h hold hasn't expired

put.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any boulder, or the boulder's own creator. A non-empty crag_id re-parents the boulder to a different spot, cascading its problems' denormalized crag_id along with it.

403.description: not the creator and not an admin

get.description: Every problem-on-this-boulder's annotation together -- one photo, many lines.
get.summary: List every line drawn on a boulder's photos

delete.summary: Remove one image from a boulder

post.description: Appends URLs already uploaded via POST /upload/topo to a boulder's image_urls.

get.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any boulder, or the boulder's own creator -- the visibility a creator needs to actually see and object to a request filed against their rock (see object, above). The admin-wide queue (list, below) stays unscoped and admin-only; this is scoped to one boulder.
get.summary: List pending merge requests filed against one boulder

post.description: Any authenticated user may suggest a merge; executing one is admin-only (see resolve).
post.summary: Suggest that two boulders are the same rock

delete.description: Allowed for the comment's own author or an admin.

post.description: Any authenticated user may create a crag; no role gate.

put.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any crag, or the crag's own creator.

403.description: not the creator and not an admin

get.description: "Jalan masuk" -- the walk in, photographed step by step. A crag may have several; each is a genuinely different walk.

delete.summary: Remove one image from a crag

post.description: Appends URLs already uploaded via POST /upload/topo to a crag's image_urls -- the approach shot.
Public, rate-limited (3 per 5s per IP). Open to logged-out visitors -- runs OptionalAuth so a logged-in submitter's user_id is attached when present.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's notifications, newest first.
Optional crag_id/boulder_id query params filter to one crag or boulder.

post.description: Any authenticated user may create a problem; no role gate. boulder_id is required -- crag_id is derived from the boulder, not supplied directly.

delete.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any problem, or the problem's own creator. Does not touch the boulder's shared photos -- only the problem row and its own annotation (cascades).

put.description: Allowed for admins (Council/Associate title) on any problem, or the problem's own creator. A non-empty boulder_id re-parents the problem to a different rock, dropping any annotation it had (a line on the old rock's photo means nothing on the new one).

403.description: not the creator and not an admin

put.description: One vector-shape overlay per (problem, image_url). Allowed for admins or the problem's own creator.

post.summary: Add a comment to a problem

delete.summary: Remove one image from a problem

post.description: Appends URLs already uploaded via POST /upload/topo to a problem's image_urls -- beta/action shots, never the topo base.

post.summary: Toggle a send (tick) on this problem

get.summary: Whether the authenticated user has sent this problem
Get a profile's recent sends and problems
Total reaction counts on a profile
Which reactions the authenticated user gave this profile

parameters.description: Reaction type: like, fire, or heart
parameters.name: type

post.summary: Toggle a reaction on a profile

post.description: Admin-only. Action is either "remove" (deletes the reported content) or "dismiss".

get.description:
Backs client-side "sent by me" filtering over a problem
listing without an N+1 per-problem send-status call.
get.summary: Problem IDs the authenticated user has sent

post.description: Streams an image to Cloudinary's kepalabatu_avatars folder, returns its URL.

400.description: no file, file too large, or not an image

post.description: Streams an image to Cloudinary's kepalabatu_topos folder, returns its URL.

400.description: no file, file too large, or not an image

post.description: Adds an email to the pre-launch waitlist. A repeat submission of an already-registered email is treated as a success (already_joined: true), not an error.

200.description: email was already on the waitlist

post.description: Always returns the same generic success message regardless of whether the email exists, to avoid leaking account existence.

400.description: invalid body, too-short new password, or wrong current password

post.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returns a JWT and the user record.

400.description: invalid body, bad credentials, or unverified email

post.description: Creates the user + profile rows in one transaction and sends a verification email; the whole signup is rolled back if the email fails to send.

get.description: Backs the landing page's climber-count stat. Unauthenticated, same trust level as GET /problems.
